routing_principle: Use Codex GPT-5.6 Sol for Codex worker lanes. Reserve Claude only for work that genuinely needs a different provider's taste, ambiguity reduction, or cross-domain judgment. Pick the Codex reasoning effort by task depth: 'fast' (low/medium) for quick deterministic edits where speed matters; 'xhigh' for hard coding/design/debugging where correctness matters more than latency. Do not pay xhigh for a one-line rename; do not run fast on a subtle concurrency bug. GPT-5.5 is prohibited for new Codex lanes.

claude.use_for: reasoning, taste, design judgment, ambiguity, synthesis across domains

codex_fast.use_for: quick deterministic edits, renames, file ops, mechanical refactors, fast checks — speed over depth

codex_deep.use_for: hard implementation, subtle bugs, architecture-bearing code, thorough review — correctness over speed

taste.recipe: Product judgment, UX critique, design direction.

mechanical.recipe: Deterministic edits, file ops, repeatable checks — speed matters.

debug.recipe: Root-cause a bug/test failure — think hard.

review.recipe: Adversarial diff review, regression + verification passes.
